messages:
maria: Quick question — for the console snapshot feature, should incremental snapshots of a per-route saved query capture only the visible filter subset or the entire route state (filters + model pinning + compare lanes)?
jon: my vote is subset: visible filters + model pins. don't save transient UI like expanded panels. keeps mental model simple.
ben: Concern: telemetry and regression checks expect a stable query seed. If snapshot only captures visible subset, evals and traffic sampling might mismatch historical baselines.
anya: +1 to jon for UX simplicity, but we need a clear API contract. think we should separate `query` vs `presentation` in the payload (so consumers know what changed).
vivian: propose two-layer model: `query` (filters + model_pin + time range) and `presentation` (layout + lanes + compare state). default save = `query` only; add `include_presentation=true` opt-in.
maria: nice. what are the implications for routing/quotas if someone saves presentation with pinned heavy models? could route to dedicated tier unexpectedly.
ops-bot: NOTE: if a saved_query includes model pin to a dedicated capacity tier, billing tag `quota:pinned_model` must be attached to the request for proper chargeback.
ben: example payload (for discussion):
```json
{
  "name":"Fast failure analysis",
  "type":"route",
  "query":{"filters":[{"k":"status","op":"eq","v":"500"}],"model_pin":"rwd-3b-beta"},
  "presentation":{"view":"compare","lanes":["route","model"]}
}
```
Keep `query` canonical and machine-evaluable. `presentation` is optional and UI-only.
anya: for rollouts: make `include_presentation` opt-in in the save dialog and include a short warning about cost + telemetry divergence. default off.
jon: UX mock idea: small toggle labeled 'Save layout (includes pinned models & compare lanes)' with a hover tooltip showing estimated added cost and quota exposure.
maria: sounds good. can someone own an itemized spec: API fields, migration path for existing saves, and UX copy for the toggle and tooltip? I'll convert to a PR after specs land.
vivian: I'll handle quota tagging + admin opt-out flag. will also add telemetry attribution tests to ensure saved vs live sampling is clear.
ben: I'll draft regression test matrix to avoid silent eval drift when presentation is included.
jon: I'll push a quick mock into figma and link it here once done.
maria: thanks — owners: @jon mock, @anya API schema, @vivian billing hooks, @ben regression tests. ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
